notes.title: 【Vampiress: Eternal Duet】August Retest! Wishlist Campaign! Dev Log 06.28~06.30
notes.content:
[p][b]August Internal Test Invitation![/b][/p][p]We received lots of feedback during the Steam Next Fest demo! The current version of the game indeed has many shortcomings, so major changes are coming – we're working hard on them![/p][p]We plan to have several internal tests before the official release. The nearest one is scheduled for early August. We sincerely invite you all to participate and experience the "rebirth" of [i]Blood Princess: Twin Rebirth[/i]![/p][p]For this August new version internal test, friends who want to join should make sure to join our community channels! Test details and game access will be announced there. Active participation in testing and providing feedback will earn you a chance to win an official game activation code![/p][p][b]Folks, please add the game to your wishlist![/b][/p][p][b][i]Blood Princess: Twin Rebirth[/i] Steam Wishlist Goal: 10,000![/b][/p][p]We're currently less than one-third of the way there! Give us a boost, partners![/p][p][/p][p][b]Development Log: June 28-30, 2025[/b][/p][p][b]\[Game Mechanics][/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the core logic of the buff system.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies will no longer perform main attacks while executing buff attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Buff types simplified to Damage and Protection, corresponding to Staff and Scythe mode skill defenses.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Protagonist][/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimized and modified the protagonist's skill animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the Scythe couldn't be used in the Prologue.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Enemies][/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the wind-up animation for the Rhino enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the damage values for all enemy skills (mostly increased).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Levels][/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated mission configurations for the Prologue and Chapter 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the level logic for Chapter 2, Mission 1: Players now need to press a button to detonate the facility behind them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the guidance bug in Chapter 1, Mission 1.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Scenes][/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated scene dialogue configurations, camera setups, and layouts for specific levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Prologue level and optimized maps for Chapter 1 and Chapter 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the combat enclosure wall blueprints.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Animation][/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the Fox Ronin's dodge and face-hit animations.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Contact & Community Links:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Steam Group:[/b] Realm Weaver Round Table

notes.title: A remake before the game is even released?
notes.content: [p][/p][p][b]Preface:[/b] Our Steam Group is now open! You can join by searching for: [b]织界者圆桌厅堂 (Realm Weaver Round Table)[/b] or by visiting the URL directly: [/p][p][url="http://steamcommunity.com/groups/RealmWeaverRT"]http://steamcommunity.com/groups/RealmWeaverRT[/url][/p][p]Join the Steam Group and chat with players worldwide![/p][p][/p][p]The Steam Next Fest June edition has concluded successfully. Many players have experienced the demo for Vampiress Eternal Duet, and we've received loads of feedback. The current version has significant shortcomings and sincerely appreciate all players’ feedback.[/p][p] [/p][p]All studio members dedicate their spare time to development, with over half of us not being industry professionals. This is our first project of this kind, we are learning from our mistakes and this experience. We deeply appreciate your patience, encouragement, and constructive criticism![/p][p] [/p][p]After consideration, we've compiled the feedback and want to communicate major upcoming changes. This also serves to gather further feedback to help us improve the game.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Demo Feedback Summary:[/h2][p] [/p][h3]Bug Reports:[/h3][p]1. Sliding occurs on small steps.[/p][p]2. Enemies get stuck on the edges of traversable platforms.[/p][p]3. Characters slide into backrooms during climbing and get stuck.[/p][p]4. Ground material reflection error in Chapter 1 Quest 1.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Visual & Audio Feedback:[/h3][p]1. Unstable frame rate; severe frame drops in certain scenes/configurations.[/p][p]2. Attack, climb, and dash sound effects lack of impact. Background music lacks fade-in/fade-out, makes it obtrusive. Overall audio negatively impacts combat feedback and interactivity.[/p][p]3. Missing voice acting; dialogue appears awkward.[/p][p]4. UI looks cheap and doesn’t fit well with the art style.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Gameplay & Progression Feedback:[/h3][p]1. Limited enemy variety and move sets; repetitive combat encounters across different scenes.[/p][p]2. climbing feels weird, sometimes triggers bugs.[/p][p]3. Missing hint when purchasing skills.[/p][p]4. Skill activation feels strange: Depending on the character’s faceward direction. Stay put when releasing skills. Lack of bullet time combined with strict input windows makes skills unresponsive.[/p][p]5. Core mechanics feel overly punitive: Vampire Mode consumes HP to boost attacks, while Normal attacks consumes skill bar for healing/stun attacks. On higher difficulties, one-hit kills render HP loss meaningless.[/p][p]6. Lack of guidance in Chapter 1, Quest 1's final section.[/p][p]7. Demo’s final boss lacks interactivity; attack too swiftly, preventing close combat tension.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Future Plans: Major Game Framework Overhaul[/h2][h3]Reconstruction of the core combat mechanism：[/h3][p]1. Gameplay mechanics rework:[/p][list][*][p]Vampire Mode: HP no longer drains automatically. HP drains gradually with attacks/skills. Auto-switches to Normal mode when HP drops below a threshold.[/p][/*][*][p]Normal Mode: Healing no longer relies on skill bar. Landing hits directly restores HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Build Rage through attacks. A full Rage bar enables Ultimate move.[/p][/*][/list][p]2. Remove current Execution system. You can execution only on the "off-balance" status (details below in Enrage mechanics).[/p][p]3. Skill System Rework:[/p][list][*][p]Cancel skill activation depending on directions.[/p][/*][*][p]Add default slow motion to Focus Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Skills gain the ability to counter enemy buffs of specific colors.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Level & Combat Mechanics Rework:[/h3][p]1. Increase combat tempo. Player kill efficiency will higher damage, countered by facing larger enemy waves...[/p][p]2. Introduce new level mechanics to increase enemy threat:[/p][p]Implement an Enrage mechanic. Enraged enemies gain different colored buff types (e.g., Protection, Damage, teleportation), each with unique effects and skills layered onto their base behavior.[/p][p]Player skills are modified: Hitting an enemy with a skill matching its Enrage color interrupts its buff skill, instantly applying "off-balance".[/p][p]Only another attack on "off-balance" enemies trigger Executions for quick kills.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Audiovisual Experience Optimize:[/h3][p]1. Enhance sound effects for better effect.[/p][p]2. Refine background music; implement fade-in/fade-out based on combat triggers.[/p][p]3. Overhaul HP/Stun UI bars for clearer visual feedback on damage and stun status.[/p][p]4. Improve climbing feel and sound effects.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Game Flow & Content Optimize:[/h3][p]1. Adjust highest difficulty damage figure.[/p][p]2. Revise dialogue presentation for a more clear and natural flow.[/p][p]3. Improve level guidance, maintaining a smooth experience.[/p][p]4. Add the new Enrage mechanic to diversify enemy encounters, adjust enemy deployment to reducing repetition.[/p][p][/p][p]We also received invaluable feedback from global players on Xiaoheihe (CN gaming community), Steam Community, and Bilibili. Thank you again to everyone who contributed![/p][p] [/p][p]As evident, we're undertaking significant changes. Therefore, we crave more frequent feedback on these new mechanics! For ,more future playtests, please join our official communities.[/p][p] [/p][p]We've also added a dedicated Steam Group:[/p][p]Realm Weaver Round Table[/p][p]Or use the URL to visit the page:[/p][p][/p][p][url="http://steamcommunity.com/groups/RealmWeaverRT"]http://steamcommunity.com/groups/RealmWeaverRT[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Join the Steam Group to discuss with players all over the world![/p][p] [/p][p]Every member of Realm Weaver Studio dedicates their spare time to this project. We eagerly seek active communication with our players. And hope that with everyone's play and feedback, we can continue to improve the game content, make it a game we're all proud of![/p][p] [/p][p]Steam Group: Realm Weaver Round Table[/p][p][/p][p][url="http://steamcommunity.com/groups/RealmWeaverRT"]http://steamcommunity.com/groups/RealmWeaverRT[/url][/p][p][/p][p]QQ Group: 772530189[/p][p]Bilibili: 织界者游戏工作室[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://space.bilibili.com/181998772"]https://space.bilibili.com/181998772[/url][/p][p][/p][p]xiaoheihe: 织界者游戏工作室[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://web.xiaoheihe.cn/bbs/user_profile_share?user_id=81683537&h_src=dev"]https://web.xiaoheihe.cn/bbs/user_profile_share?user_id=81683537&h_src=dev[/url][/p][p][/p][p]xiaoheihe:血姬:双生[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://api.xiaoheihe.cn/game/share_game_detail?appid=3660110&game_type=pc&h_src=dev"]https://api.xiaoheihe.cn/game/share_game_detail?appid=3660110&game_type=pc&h_src=dev[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Rednote: 织界者游戏工作室[/p][p]Gcores: 织界者游戏工作室[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.gcores.com/users/853914/talks"]https://www.gcores.com/users/853914/talks[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Email: [url="https://realm_weaver@outlook.com"]realm_weaver@outlook.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p] [/p]
